scope.historical_scope: Read-only local project records available at inventory time, before new Strong-development model requests.
limitations: Local not_found is not proof of global non-exposure.
No claim about provider pretraining, external projects, deleted records, or unlogged prompts.
Payload hashes cannot reveal full wire prompts; historical identities used checkpoint/collection/manifest-to-ledger bindings.
Metadata, private QC, teacher controls and scripted fixtures were not counted as real provider task exposure.
Image availability and historical environment acceptance do not establish current formal admission.
This projection does not reread raw ledgers, checkpoints, model responses, SQLite, source-rows, gold patches or hidden tests.

source_reference_policy: Logical source IDs resolve through source_index.json; private record contents are not uploaded.
